text:
Cypress (15 and 16) helper for this template — in a Cypress suite, use it as written:
Facts:
  • hidden radio inputs, operated by their labels — click the label, assert the input
  • the inputs carry the option name in aria-label and a value ("teams" / "individuals") in name="plan_type_selector"
```js
const planTypeInput = (option) => cy.get(`input[name="plan_type_selector"][aria-label="${option}"]`);
const selectPlanType = (option) =>
  planTypeInput(option).invoke('attr', 'id').then((id) => cy.get(`label[for="${id}"]`).click());
```
Proof: run in Cypress 16 against this page — every value finds exactly its own element; partial names do not match.
